gloss: to come in; to flow in; to enter (toward the speaker)

definitions.gloss: to come in; to enter (moving toward the speaker or scene)
definitions.explanation: Compound of {入|はい}る (to enter) + くる (to come). Expresses the movement of something entering a space from outside, with the directional sense of movement toward the speaker or the focal scene. Used for people, air, light, information, or other things flowing in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷気|れいき}→冷気：21352_reiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{入|はい}ってくる。
examples.english: Cold air comes in through the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}ってきた。
SNS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}じて⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|はい}ってくるようになった。
examples.english: Information has come to flow in from overseas through social media as well.

notes:
The ～てくる pattern attached to ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ conveys that the entering is directed toward the speaker or scene. Compare ⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧いく (to go in, moving away) and ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (neutral).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}ってくる: to come into the room
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|はい}ってくる: information comes in
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|はい}ってくる: light comes in
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|はい}ってくる: a breeze comes in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter — neutral, no directional connotation
- ⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧いく: to go in — the movement is away from the speaker
